entities.name: LandingGatesInfra
observations: Bootstrapped Doxa's standard landing-gate infrastructure for this repo: KG Guard + Claude Code Review GitHub Actions workflows, kg-save-gate/review-gate/test-gate PreToolUse hooks, session-start-kg-import + pre-compact-kg-export hooks, attest-review.sh + knowledge-graph-merkle.cjs (CommonJS, this repo's package.json has type:module), and this initial .knowledge-graph/graph.json. Ported from openclaw's landing-gates suite per doxa-cns CLAUDE.md PR-visibility/bank-the-gold/kg-save-on-every-merge doctrine. claude-code-review.yml's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret is NOT yet configured on GitHub — workflow is inert until Garth adds it.

entities.name: KgMerkleFixesPropagated
observations: Propagated the 2026-08-11 atomic-write and --type-guard fixes from doxa-cns's canonical knowledge-graph-merkle.js.

entities.name: ReviewWorkflowDeadCondition
observations: claude-code-review.yml (just added in #14) copied the pre-fix openclaw template's if: condition referencing github.event.pull_request.* while the trigger is workflow_dispatch only, which always evaluates false. Confirmed by an async /code-review that returned after #14 merged. Same bug independently fixed the same day in doxa-cns, openclaw, and doxa-shared.

entities.name: KgMergeIntegrityGuard
observations: Ported the merge-resolve tool + mechanical merge-integrity guard from doxa-cns's canonical knowledge-graph-merkle.js (2026-08-13, Garth: 'standing doctrine and practice across all repos'). Used it to actually resolve this repo's own stalled PR #15 conflict (which had gone unmerged since 2026-08-11 for the same class of reason this guard exists to prevent).
